content: The R. al-Inzāliyya treats the revelation of the heavenly Books successively from exoteric, mystical and lettrist perspectives, and rejects two standard views of inzāl (a spatial movement from heaven to earth, and the emergence of what was hidden) in favour of the Sufis' applied metaphysical sense; it was published by Bihbahānī in 1349 Sh./1971.
